notes: Curated eval for the craft-pass output contract. Routing prompts stay on practitioner language; output checks require the skill's leading test, not a section list.

should_trigger.prompt: Please design an adaptive discovery guide and outcome-led demo flow for a defined buyer, segment, stage, and meeting type.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable discovery and demo structure and label anything that still needs confirmation.
I only have partial source material for discovery and demo structure. Make useful progress and label what still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please write persona- and stage-specific spoken language for a defined conversation moment or an existing call structure.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Names the meeting decision, gates each demo block on a buyer signal, and keeps hypotheses labeled until confirmed.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-and-demo-structure-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
